meanings.en: the state of being completely forgotten
meanings.exampleEn: The once-famous singer sank into oblivion.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir zamanlar ünlü olan şarkıcı unutulup gitti.

meanings.en: the state of being unconscious or unaware
meanings.exampleEn: He drank himself into oblivion.
meanings.exampleTr: İçe içe kendinden geçti.

meanings.en: the state of not being aware of what is happening around you
meanings.exampleEn: Her obliviousness to the danger worried everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Tehlikenin farkında olmaması herkesi endişelendirdi.

meanings.en: offensive or disgusting in a sexual or morally shocking way
meanings.exampleEn: The website was shut down for showing obscene images.
meanings.exampleTr: Site müstehcen görüntüler yayınladığı için kapatıldı.

meanings.en: morally offensive because of being excessive
meanings.exampleEn: They earn obscene amounts of money.
meanings.exampleTr: Ahlaksızca miktarlarda para kazanıyorlar.

meanings.en: the practice of obeying a law, rule, or custom
meanings.exampleEn: The observance of traffic laws saves lives.
meanings.exampleTr: Trafik kurallarına uyulması hayat kurtarır.

meanings.en: the celebration of a religious or traditional event
meanings.exampleEn: The observance of Ramadan is important to the family.
meanings.exampleTr: Ramazan'ın idrak edilmesi aile için önemlidir.

meanings.en: no longer used or useful because something newer has replaced it
meanings.exampleEn: Typewriters have become obsolete.
meanings.exampleTr: Daktilolar artık modası geçmiş hale geldi.

meanings.en: deliberately causing difficulties or blocking progress
meanings.exampleEn: The manager was obstructive and refused to cooperate.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür engelleyici davrandı ve iş birliği yapmayı reddetti.

meanings.en: the quality of being easy to see or understand
meanings.exampleEn: The obviousness of the mistake embarrassed him.
meanings.exampleTr: Hatanın apaçık ortada olması onu utandırdı.

meanings.tr: (astronomi) örtülme, bir gök cisminin başka biriyle gizlenmesi
meanings.en: the hiding of one celestial body by another passing in front of it
meanings.exampleEn: Astronomers observed the occultation of the star by the Moon.
meanings.exampleTr: Gökbilimciler yıldızın Ay tarafından örtülmesini gözlemledi.

meanings.en: a person who lives in or uses a building, room, or vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: The occupants of the house were evacuated safely.
meanings.exampleTr: Evin sakinleri güvenli bir şekilde tahliye edildi.

meanings.en: relating to a job or profession
meanings.exampleEn: Back pain is a common occupational hazard for drivers.
meanings.exampleTr: Bel ağrısı sürücüler için yaygın bir mesleki risktir.

meanings.en: something that happens; an event
meanings.exampleEn: Power cuts are a common occurrence in the area.
meanings.exampleTr: Elektrik kesintileri bölgede sık görülen bir olaydır.

meanings.en: toward the ocean
meanings.exampleEn: The river flows oceanward through the valley.
meanings.exampleTr: Nehir vadi boyunca okyanusa doğru akar.

meanings.en: relating to the eyes or vision
meanings.exampleEn: The disease can cause serious ocular damage.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalık ciddi göz hasarına yol açabilir.

meanings.en: the quality of being strange or unusual
meanings.exampleEn: There was an oddness about the way he spoke.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşma tarzında bir tuhaflık vardı.

meanings.en: extremely unpleasant and causing hatred
meanings.exampleEn: He compared the two leaders in an odious way.
meanings.exampleTr: İki lideri iğrenç bir şekilde kıyasladı.

meanings.en: belonging to, relating to, or connected with something
meanings.exampleEn: She is a friend of mine.
meanings.exampleTr: O benim bir arkadaşımdır.

meanings.en: used to show an amount or part of something
meanings.exampleEn: He drank a cup of coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir fincan kahve içti.

meanings.en: used to say yes or to show that something is obvious or expected
meanings.exampleEn: Of course you can come with us.
meanings.exampleTr: Tabii ki bizimle gelebilirsin.

meanings.en: during a period when demand or activity is lower than usual
meanings.exampleEn: Train tickets are cheaper during off-peak hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Tren biletleri yoğun olmayan saatlerde daha ucuzdur.

meanings.en: unpleasant in a way that makes you not want something
meanings.exampleEn: The smell was rather off-putting.
meanings.exampleTr: Koku oldukça iticiydi.

meanings.en: the young or children of a person or animal
meanings.exampleEn: The birds feed their offspring several times a day.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuşlar yavrularını günde birkaç kez besler.

meanings.en: comparative of old; having lived or existed for a longer time
meanings.exampleEn: My older brother works in London.
meanings.exampleTr: Benim ağabeyim Londra'da çalışıyor.

meanings.en: in theory rather than in reality; as it appears in writing
meanings.exampleEn: On paper, the plan looks perfect, but it may fail in practice.
meanings.exampleTr: Kâğıt üzerinde plan kusursuz görünüyor ama uygulamada başarısız olabilir.

meanings.en: used to say the opposite of what has just been said is true
meanings.exampleEn: I'm not tired; on the contrary, I feel great.
meanings.exampleTr: Yorgun değilim; aksine harika hissediyorum.

meanings.en: used to introduce a different or opposing point of view
meanings.exampleEn: It's cheap; on the other hand, the quality is poor.
meanings.exampleTr: Ucuz; öte yandan kalitesi düşük.

meanings.en: happening one time each year
meanings.exampleEn: It is a once-a-year event that everyone looks forward to.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, herkesin dört gözle beklediği yılda bir kez olan bir etkinliktir.

meanings.en: considering only one side or point of view; unfair
meanings.exampleEn: The report gave a very one-sided account of the events.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor olayları çok tek taraflı bir şekilde aktardı.

meanings.en: unequal, with one side much stronger than the other
meanings.exampleEn: The match was a one-sided contest.
meanings.exampleTr: Maç tek taraflı bir mücadeleydi.

meanings.en: used as the reflexive form of the pronoun 'one'
meanings.exampleEn: It is important to take care of oneself.
meanings.exampleTr: Kişinin kendine bakması önemlidir.

meanings.en: continuing to exist or develop
meanings.exampleEn: The investigation is still ongoing.
meanings.exampleTr: Soruşturma hâlâ devam ediyor.

meanings.tr: başlangıç, ortaya çıkış (genellikle olumsuz bir şeyin)
meanings.en: the beginning of something, especially something unpleasant
meanings.exampleEn: The onset of winter brought heavy snow.
meanings.exampleTr: Kışın başlaması yoğun kar getirdi.

meanings.en: generous with money or possessions
meanings.exampleEn: She was open-handed with her time and money.
meanings.exampleTr: Zamanı ve parası konusunda eli açıktı.

meanings.en: willingness to consider new ideas or opinions
meanings.exampleEn: Her open-mindedness made her a great leader.
meanings.exampleTr: Açık fikirliliği onu harika bir lider yaptı.

meanings.en: the quality of being generous
meanings.exampleEn: His openhandedness toward the poor was well known.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoksullara karşı cömertliği herkesçe biliniyordu.

meanings.en: the process of making something as effective or efficient as possible
meanings.exampleEn: The company focused on the optimization of its supply chain.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket tedarik zincirini en uygun hale getirmeye odaklandı.

meanings.en: used to link alternatives
meanings.exampleEn: Would you like tea or coffee?
meanings.exampleTr: Çay mı yoksa kahve mi istersin?

meanings.en: the quality of being usual and not special
meanings.exampleEn: There is a certain beauty in the ordinariness of daily life.
meanings.exampleTr: Günlük hayatın sıradanlığında belli bir güzellik vardır.

meanings.tr: organik gıda, doğal yöntemlerle üretilen yiyecek
meanings.en: food produced without artificial chemicals or pesticides
meanings.exampleEn: Many shoppers prefer organic food for health reasons.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok alışverişçi sağlık nedeniyle organik gıdayı tercih eder.

meanings.en: in a way that uses no artificial chemicals
meanings.exampleEn: These vegetables are grown organically.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sebzeler organik olarak yetiştirilir.

meanings.en: in a way that develops naturally and gradually
meanings.exampleEn: The business grew organically over the years.
meanings.exampleTr: İş yıllar içinde doğal olarak büyüdü.

meanings.en: a person who plans and arranges an event or activity
meanings.exampleEn: The organiser of the conference welcomed the guests.
meanings.exampleTr: Konferansın düzenleyicisi misafirleri karşıladı.

meanings.en: a device or item used to keep things arranged and tidy
meanings.exampleEn: She keeps her appointments in a personal organiser.
meanings.exampleTr: Randevularını kişisel bir ajandada tutuyor.

meanings.tr: doğuya ait, Doğu ile ilgili (özellikle Asya)
meanings.en: relating to or characteristic of the East, especially Asia
meanings.exampleEn: The room was decorated with oriental rugs.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda doğu tarzı halılarla döşenmişti.

meanings.en: the type of aims or interests a person or organization has
meanings.exampleEn: The company has a strong customer orientation.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin güçlü bir müşteri yönelimi var.

meanings.en: training or information given to prepare someone for a new activity
meanings.exampleEn: New employees attend an orientation on their first day.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni çalışanlar ilk günlerinde bir oryantasyona katılır.

meanings.en: the first version of a book or publication as it was first produced
meanings.exampleEn: Collectors pay a lot for the original edition of the novel.
meanings.exampleTr: Koleksiyoncular romanın orijinal baskısına çok para öder.

meanings.en: a person who creates or starts something
meanings.exampleEn: She is the originator of the idea.
meanings.exampleTr: Fikri ortaya atan kişi odur.

meanings.en: a generally accepted belief, opinion, or practice
meanings.exampleEn: He challenged the economic orthodoxy of his time.
meanings.exampleTr: Zamanının iktisadi genel kabullerine meydan okudu.

meanings.en: strict adherence to accepted religious beliefs
meanings.exampleEn: Religious orthodoxy shaped every aspect of their lives.
meanings.exampleTr: Dini ortodoksluk hayatlarının her yönünü şekillendirdi.

meanings.en: as appears or is stated to be true, though not necessarily so
meanings.exampleEn: He left ostensibly for health reasons.
meanings.exampleTr: Görünüşte sağlık nedeniyle ayrıldı.

meanings.en: designed to impress or attract attention in a showy way
meanings.exampleEn: They lived in an ostentatious mansion.
meanings.exampleTr: Gösterişli bir malikânede yaşıyorlardı.
